_doc: POST <gateway_url>/v1/sdk/credential/revoke with the SDK key as bearer (section 13.7): a key ends itself; setup --forget calls it, then removes the SDK-held file (the file goes even when the revoke fails, and setup says so). No body. The answer is the SDK control API envelope (api_version, request_id) with revoked 1; a key that is already revoked or unknown is the gateway's usual 401.

body.message: the SDK key is not valid
